task.source_name: Ripple issue-linked change dataset (record instance-00010; used for candidate discovery and cross-check only)
task.issue_text_source: ASF Jira REST API v2 issue IVY-1028 fields created,summary,description; timestamp and original request checked 2026-10-25; https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/issue/IVY-1028?fields=created,summary,description
task.selection_decision: Selected for a one-task pilot after verifying the official Jira creation timestamp precedes the target, the target's first parent equals the recorded parent, and the complete parent-to-target Git diff path set. Evaluation label is every changed path in the target patch, including CHANGES.txt; Ripple impact-set-files is separately recorded metadata and is not used as ground truth.
cleaning_decisions: Use original issue summary plus cleaned opening technical problem statement; omit quoted mail headers, contact addresses, and follow-up discussion.
Ground truth is exact Git diff path set from parent to target; do not substitute Ripple impact-set-files.
No target diff/body, commit message, changed paths, or post-target repository content is included in predictor input.

predictor_input_policy.constraint_type: full parent-revision file tree in prompt

baselines.seed_selection: first deterministic lexical source rank from request text against parent snapshot

model_run.error: PredictionError: predicted path is not present at parent commit: src/java/org/apache/ivy/plugins/resolver/AbstractDependencyResolver.java

limitations: One task and one model call are a pilot only, not conclusive evidence.
Changed-path labels are not a complete oracle for every file potentially affected.
Issue cleaning decisions are recorded in the task manifest.
C0_CONSTRAINED is a candidate-list prompt condition, not a hard decoding constraint; invalid paths are still rejected.
